title: Plain-language 'Why?' narrative over clozn.diagnosis-findings.v1 and a structural run comparison (D2)
description: clozn.runs.diagnosis_narratives.narrate()'s output. NEVER persisted as a stored blob -- like clozn.diagnosis-findings.v1 (D1) and clozn.performance-trace.v1, it is recomputed fresh on every call from its inputs (a run, an optional comparison run, an optional already-computed clozn.diagnosis-findings.v1 document); a registered schema is still warranted because this document's SHAPE is a contract multiple consumers (this module's own HTTP route, a future D5 guided-repair UI) rely on, and roadmap rule 7's 'stored artifact' language has never been read in this codebase as exempting a recomputed-on-demand JSON shape -- see clozn.performance-trace.v1 for the exact same precedent. THE BOUNDARY THIS SCHEMA ENCODES: run comparison is STRUCTURAL DIFFERENCE, never causal attribution. `registers.observed_changes` states structural facts from clozn.analysis.run_diff.compare_runs() ONLY -- it is never ranked and never implies one change explains another. `registers.measured_effects` is a RANKED list, but every entry is required to name a `rule_id` from a real clozn.diagnosis-findings.v1 status=='finding' entry (or, for a future intervention artifact, `basis: "intervention"`) -- 'no finding, no factor' is enforced by this schema's own required fields, not merely by convention. `registers.plausible_but_unproven` carries a hypothesis (currently: an output difference despite identical identity/settings, i.e. possible sampling sensitivity) explicitly marked unproven and is NEVER assigned a `rank` -- the schema has no `rank` property on that entry shape at all, so a document that tried to rank one would fail validation, not merely convention review.

evidence_ref.description: Every narrative sentence links back to evidence: a clozn.diagnosis-findings.v1 rule_id, a clozn.analysis.run_diff dotted dimension path, or a clozn.text-span-addresses.v1 address_id -- never a bare, unlinked sentence.

observed_entry.description: One structural fact from clozn.analysis.run_diff.compare_runs()'s own differences[] -- a plain statement of what changed, never a claim about why.

measured_entry.description: One RANKED contributing factor. required, never optional: rule_id names the exact clozn.diagnosis-findings.v1 entry (status=='finding') this factor is backed by -- 'no finding, no factor'.

basis.description: 'intervention': backed by an actual measured intervention (today: R08/R09's context_answer_influence forced_score_intervention). 'rule_finding': backed by another clozn.diagnosis-findings.v1 status=='finding' entry -- still a real, evidenced detection, never a guess.

plausible_entry.description: A clearly-labeled, UNPROVEN hypothesis -- deliberately has no `rank`, no `severity`, no `confidence`, no `rule_id`: this schema structurally forbids ranking a plausible entry above (or alongside) a measured one.

note.description: States explicitly that this entry is not backed by a rule finding and is never ranked above registers.measured_effects.

comparison_run_id.description: Present only when a comparison run was supplied -- omitted, never null, otherwise.

findings_schema_version.description: Names the schema of the clozn.diagnosis-findings.v1 document this narrative was built from (supplied by the caller or computed internally) -- the full document is not embedded here; a caller reading `registers.measured_effects[].rule_id` is expected to have it alongside (the HTTP route returns both in one response).
